PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 4, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Alvaro Castillo, Chair  Todd Lemmis, Commissioner
Michele Ware, Vice Chair  Nicholas Santos, Commissioner
Michael Clemson, Commissioner  Jane Templin, Commissioner

  Planning Commission In-Person Meeting

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments
  to planningcommissioners@longbeach.gov

  Comments may also be provided in the Zoom meeting using the raise hand function or by
  pressing *9 on your phone

  Please dial: (213) 338-8477 / Meeting ID: 934 1096 4133
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/93410964133

  Please note the Zoom meeting may encounter technical disruptions, but in-person access
  and public comment will continue to be available in accordance with the Brown Act

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55293  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report, including an update on late
  night public safety policy.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55294  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting of
  Thursday, May 7, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55295  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the Annual Update from the
  Office of Ethics and Transparency.

  Page 1 of 4
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 4, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55296  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the Brown Act from the City
  Attorney’s Office.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-55316  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE-25-138, finding the
  proposed project exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines Section 15301 (Class 1, Existing Facilities);
  and

  Approve a Conditional Use Permit (CUP25-019) and Local Coastal Development
  Permit (LCDP25-044), and adopt the proposed findings and conditions of approval
  thereto, to allow an existing restaurant to upgrade an existing California
  Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) Type 41 License (On-Sale Beer
  and Wine - Eating Place) to a ABC Type 47 License (On-Sale General - Eating
  Place) at 4702 East 2nd Street in Neighborhood Commercial and Pedestrian
  (CNP) Zoning District. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-55324  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE-26-033, finding the
  proposed project exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines Section 15303 (Class 3, New Construction or
  Conversion of Small Structures); and

  Approve a Conditional Use Permit (CUP25-023) to legalize an existing certified
  California Redemption Value (CRV) recycling center with an on-site attendant for
  eligible beverage containers, including aluminum, glass, and plastic containers
  located in an existing 2,600 square foot building at 1951 West 16th Street in the
  General Industrial (IG) Zoning District. Heavy metal recycling (i.e. copper) is not
  permitted as part of this recycling center use. (District 7)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-55326  Recommendation to consider and affirm the Zoning Administrator’s Classification
  of Use (USE26-001) determination, and adopt the proposed findings thereto, to
  allow battery energy storage systems (BESS) to align with the use determinations
  for electrical distribution substations in the Zoning Regulations (Title 21) and
  Transitional Zoning Regulations (Title 22), including at 2250 East 69th Street in the
  NI-1 (Neo-Industrial 1) Zoning District. (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

Opportunity to address the Planning Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101
or cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
